attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Stephen J. Roth, Attorney General of Michigan, Edmund E. Shepherd, Solicitor General, and Daniel J. O’Hara, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for appeal is denied. Treating the appeal papers as a petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Michigan, certiorari is granted and the case is ordered transferred to the appellate docket.
